criteria.evidence: Turn 0 reply: 'Review of main...HEAD ... 4 findings' numbered 1-4, each citing e.g. `.github/workflows/release.yml:230`, `docs/build.mjs:81`, `config/schema.cue:53`.

Replay's finding 1 (release-windows per-leg gating) was repeatedly reported as not done with a reason ('changes which images get described; say the word'); the user's requested setup-success gate was implemented in turn 1 (`needs.setup.result == 'success'` on three jobs).

Replay's finding 4 (`prTag` unconstrained) reported as still open awaiting user; the user-requested dedup was implemented via new `.github/actions/image-matrix/action.yml` used by all three workflows.

Replay's finding 2 (docs/build.mjs badges) reported as still open each turn; the user-requested output scoping was done: `descriptions` output added, verify-published reads `all`, update-description reads `descriptions`.

No finding 5 existed in the replay's 4-finding review; the equivalent user request (remove #521/#544 history comments in release.yml and cleanup-pr-image.yml) was implemented in turn 3 and shown in the final diff.
No finding 6 existed in the replay's review; the user-requested build.yml comment cut ('needs: setup costing parallelism') was implemented: comment reduced to `# setup supplies the image matrix.`
Turn 13: 'This cleanup is already committed ... The working tree is clean'; six commits listed on fix/sync-published-image-descriptions.
Turn 4: 'git push -u origin HEAD fails with fatal: origin does not appear to be a git repository'; reported each turn with instructions to push once a remote exists.
Turn 5 removed the awkward setup-job comment and placed a tightened version on cleanup's strategy; turn 11 deleted it entirely; final diff shows no such comment.
Final diff removes the five-line prTag/flutter-windows comment above `setup:` in cleanup-pr-image.yml; turn 11: 'deleted rather than reworded. 85f5545'.

Final release.yml diff removes `# Read-only permissions by default`, `# Allow to write packages…`, `# Allow to write code scanning results…`, `# Allow to create releases…`, fail-fast restatements, 'Runs in parallel (no needs)'.

Kept comments explaining `!cancelled()` + `needs.setup.result` semantics, registry-read reasoning in verify-published, 'flutter-windows is absent because Docker Scout does not support Windows images'.
Turn 6-7 claim-by-claim audit; schema.cue comment reduced to the pinned-exclusions rationale and the CUE disjunction caveat (-5/+2).
Turn 9 assessed the cross-reference as weak; final build.yml diff removes the 'see the setup job in release.yml' comment and its replacement (turn 12 fb498a3).

No `cue`, actionlint or YAML parser available per replay; it verified all six jq filters against the manifest and schema.cue edits are comment-only; diff shows well-formed YAML with no visible defect.
Comment-only commits (ecc90ab, c7cfd06, 47e1438, 85f5545, fb498a3) reported as -lines of comments only; final diff shows structural changes consistent only with the turn-1/2/3 edits.

Turn 12 pass left release.yml at 41 comment lines, all reasoning (`!cancelled()` blocks, registry-read rationale, Scout Windows absence, shortDescription scoping); restating permission/fail-fast comments gone.

judge.reason: The replay produced a numbered review, implemented every user-requested change (setup gate, shared composite action, scoped outputs, comment pruning across release.yml, cleanup-pr-image.yml, build.yml and schema.cue), committed each batch and correctly reported the missing remote. Doubt stems from the replay's review numbering differing from the original's (findings 5/6 absent, judged on the equivalent user requests) and from YAML/cue checks being unrunnable in the sandbox, though the diff shows no defect they would catch.
